final_message: Changed the agent roster and definition templates that init and config scaffold distribute to a two-level structure: concrete members named by model family that carry `model`, plus aliases that keep the earlier names. Updated init so it writes only aliases whose target provider was selected. Claude and opencode role definitions use one file per role without `model`; the expert review template was deleted (staged deletion left in the index because unstaging needed approval). Updated provider READMEs, exec-config-guide (new section on the two-level roster and migration), CHANGELOG 0.4.0, the ticket's result section, unit tests, and a new integration test.
